name: Thermal sensor specification
text: Redundant thermal sensors must agree within 15 °C; nominal range 20–60 °C. Disagreement above tolerance triggers sensor validation.

name: Power system specification
text: Bus voltage nominal 20–22 V; battery SOC below 50 % is a low-energy condition.

name: Sensor noise specification
text: Channel standard deviation above 1.5 °C over 8 s exceeds expected measurement noise.

name: Attitude control specification
text: Pointing deviation above 5° exceeds attitude tolerance.

name: Communication link specification
text: Link requires signal above -80 dBm and latency under 350 ms.

name: Payload specification
text: Payload load nominal 10–50 W; above 50 W indicates overload.

name: Power chain specification
text: Solar loss propagates: solar → power → battery → bus voltage → payload and communication.
